name: Answer with citations
summary: One assistant turn: the question, an answer still being written with numbered citations, the sources it cites with page numbers, and copy, retry and rating actions.
use: for an assistant's answer that cites its sources
a11y: The turn is aria-busy while writing and says so in a status; each citation link names its source and page and moves focus to it; every action button has a name and the ratings use aria-pressed.

use_when: a research or support assistant whose claims must be checked against named documents and pages
avoid_when: a whole conversation with many turns and a reply box: use chat-thread with ai-composer
a short inline suggestion the person accepts or rejects: use ai-suggestion
a multi-step agent run with progress per step: use agent-steps

parts.name: avatar
parts.what: the assistant's icon, hidden in a narrow box

parts.name: byline
parts.what: assistant name, mode and source count, and how long it took

parts.name: answer
parts.what: one paragraph of the answer, with numbered citation links

parts.name: citation
parts.what: a numbered link that moves focus to its source

parts.name: sources
parts.what: one cited source: number, title, details and pages

parts.name: rating
parts.what: good or bad answer, one at a time

parts.name: note
parts.what: a short status after copy or rating

empty.how: the Smart UI renderer puts one plain 'Nothing to show yet.' line in an empty list

loading.how: the Smart UI renderer draws each marked slot as a quiet block of its size while the data arrives; the static file shows the filled part

error.how: if the browser refuses to copy, the status line says so

disabled.how: set disabled on the action buttons while the answer is still being written

overflow.how: a long answer and source list grow the card; past about six sources, show the first few and a 'Show all sources' button

long_text.how: paragraphs and source titles wrap, page numbers never wrap, and a citation stays on the line with the word before it

keyboard: Tab reaches each citation link, then Copy, Retry, Good answer and Bad answer
Enter on a citation moves focus to its source, which lights up briefly
Enter or Space presses the focused button; the two ratings act as toggles and only one can be on
